seo_title: Cost of Living in Pattaya 2026: Visa, Prices, Reviews | Relocost
seo_description: How much does it cost to live in Pattaya per month, do Russians need a visa, work, rent and reviews from those who relocated. A realistic moving budget in the Relocost calculator.
intro_text: A resort on the shore of the Gulf of Thailand: visa-free entry for 60 days, a warm sea year-round and a large Russian-speaking community. Cheaper than Phuket and close to Bangkok, but noisy and touristy.
pros: Visa-free for 60 days, a warm Gulf of Thailand sea year-round
Cheaper than Phuket, with a developed Russian-speaking infrastructure
Close to Bangkok (≈2 hours) and the airports
Plenty of housing: from budget condos to villas
A 5-year DTV visa for remote workers
cons: A reputation as a noisy party resort, lots of tourists
City beaches are average — the best are nearby (Jomtien, the islands)
A hot, humid climate and a rainy season
There is no local job market, you need remote income

visa_steps.title: Visa-free entry
visa_steps.description: Up to 60 days without a visa, extendable by another 30 at the immigration office.

visa_steps.title: DTV visa (optional)
visa_steps.description: A digital nomad visa for 5 years, up to 180 days per entry.

visa_steps.title: Renting housing
visa_steps.description: Condos are rented monthly, often with a pool; a contract is needed for extensions.

visa_steps.title: Bank account
visa_steps.description: Bangkok Bank or Kasikorn — easier with a long-term visa.

visa_steps.title: Address registration
visa_steps.description: The landlord submits the address (TM30); for a long stay — check-ins every 90 days.

faq.question: Do Russian citizens need a visa for Pattaya?
faq.answer: No, visa-free for up to 60 days with a 30-day extension. For long-term living — a 5-year DTV visa.

faq.question: Is Pattaya cheaper than Phuket?
faq.answer: Usually yes — rent and daily life are noticeably more affordable, and there's more housing to choose from.

faq.question: Are there many Russians in Pattaya?
faq.answer: Yes, a developed Russian-speaking environment: shops, cafés, services and schools.

faq.question: Can I pay with a Russian card in Pattaya?
faq.answer: No, Russian cards don't work. Cash, local apps or a foreign bank card.

faq.question: What are the beaches like in Pattaya?
faq.answer: The city beach is average; cleaner and calmer in Jomtien and on the islands (Koh Larn).

faq.question: How much does it cost to live in Pattaya?
faq.answer: Budget-friendly by resort standards: a warm sea and affordable rent. The exact budget is in the calculator above.

reviews.text: I winter in Jomtien: a condo by the sea is cheap, everything can be sorted out in Russian, and Bangkok is a stone's throw away. The centre of Pattaya is noisy — I live to the side.
Sea, warmth and familiar service. I did a visa run, next I'm thinking about the DTV. The downside — the tourist bustle and the heat.
